added.summary: Moves frames where a document sets them: every font-variant-* keyword, font-feature-settings and font-kerning reach the shaper as OpenType settings with their values (oldstyle and slashed-zero figures, fractions, ligatures off, superior and inferior digits, full-width forms, kern off), not only small caps and tabular figures; settings apply after the variants, and a line is measured with the features it is drawn with.
